findings.highlight: having a match with armors on
findings.governingReading: having a match in protective equipment
findings.explanation: The mass noun is made an ungrammatical plural.

findings.highlight: you could have put pads on
findings.evidenceJa: シロウが鎧を着るだけで模擬戦は出来ました
findings.governingReading: a mock battle was possible if Shirou simply wore armor
findings.explanation: Shirou’s full protective armor is narrowed to unspecified pads.

findings.highlight: Saber is so cute even when she’s annoyed
findings.evidenceJa: 不満そうに口をとがらせるセイバー
findings.explanation: Her concrete, comic expression is replaced by an inferred emotion.

findings.highlight: possible for you to take a match from me
findings.evidenceJa: 私から一本とる事もユメではありません
findings.governingReading: It is no dream for you to score one point against me.
findings.explanation: A limited kendo achievement becomes winning an entire match.

findings.evidenceJa: 皆伝を与えられたようなもん
findings.governingReading: like being granted full transmission/mastery by his teacher
findings.explanation: The scale and martial-teaching meaning of Saber’s praise disappear.

findings.highlight: I could even win a match against you if chance favored me
findings.evidenceJa: うまく虚をつけば、セイバーから一本とれる
findings.governingReading: If he catches Saber off guard skillfully, he can score a point.
findings.explanation: A tactical opening and limited point become luck and a whole victory.
Truthfulness is replaced by physical fullness.
A momentary weakening becomes total disappearance, with broken agreement.

findings.highlight: You can fight me in your style as well
findings.evidenceJa: 自由に、思うままに剣を振るってください
findings.governingReading: Swing your sword freely, exactly as you wish.
findings.explanation: Saber’s invitation to unrestricted self-directed movement is generalized into “your style.”

findings.highlight: It’s more like us to be fighting than talking
findings.evidenceJa: 竹刀を合わせた方が俺たちらしい
findings.governingReading: Crossing bamboo swords is more like them than talking.
findings.explanation: Their specific shared practice becomes generic fighting.

findings.evidenceJa: 互いの竹刀だけを感じていた
findings.governingReading: They were aware of nothing but each other’s bamboo sword.
findings.explanation: The exclusive concentration is lost in awkward bodily-sounding English.
